commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
He goes on, to her friend.

I never knew the sorrow of evening, or the stalk that is its medicine. She of the small bangles strung like a garland gave me both. Desire is there at other hours but flowers at evening, and the stalk comes from that, so she gave that disgrace too. She is so young she will say what you tell her. She gave these, so you can remove them.
